integrity: Every labeled tournament through five alternatives is exhaustively generated. Copeland membership and uncovered membership are each reconstructed by two independent exact formulations, and all relevant first-layer tournaments are canonicalized under every alternative relabeling.
scientific_limitations: The exhaustive classification covers tournaments only through five alternatives. Ordinary set disagreement starts at four alternatives; the order-five threshold is specifically for a unique Copeland winner together with a strictly larger uncovered set. No frequency claim is made for larger tournaments.
title: Five alternatives are the sharp decisiveness boundary between Copeland and the uncovered set
